cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Drop the Armor
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to lower their guard, stop performing strength, or admit what affects them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Shop's locked. Lose the customer voice. I taught you that smile for selling shoes, not for talking to me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Someone has to keep morale up. You're my only employee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you're still doing the trainee smile when you're frightened. I'm off the clock. What happened after you counted the till?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I cried in the stockroom. Then I practised smiling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You never used to practise anything that hard. Come out here with me next time. You don't have to get your face right first.
